title: Isomorphism relations on classes of c.e. algebras
summary: We investigate the complexity of isomorphism relations for classes of finitely generated and n-generated computably enumerable (c.e.) algebras, presented via c.e. presentations -- that is, as quotients of term algebras over decidable sets of generators by c.e. congruences. Our goal is to develop a systematic framework for analyzing such isomorphism problems from a computability-theoretic perspective.
